history.event: Claude refinement: 30 line(s) suggested — Corrected garbled common words (Ricordo chome, spedalingho, scā maria nuova, pregio, terzo di fiorino, septimana, scrivano), florin sums read as ƒß instead of ƒƒ, the fraction 1/3 misread as '2 … 10', 53→57, and ꝓ→ꝑ in 'per' contexts; the sum 19 1/3 florins in words (l16–17), in the text (l26–27) and in the column (l31) now agrees. | layout: l1: the dots on either side of .1473. sit at or just outside the box edge; l6: not a figure but the large closing bracket ) that groups the first entry (l3–l5) toward its sum in l7; could be deleted or kept as ')'; l7: the line runs into the sums column (___ ƒƒ xx. ld) on the right; the first entry's sum sits in the same box as the text; l26: the box covers only the figure 19 at the start of the manuscript line that continues in l27 (19. 1/3. di ƒ. ld. …); merge l26 into l27; l31: the sum ƒƒ 19. 1/3 ld. on the right is inside the same box as the text; the 3 of the fraction hangs below the outline | doubts: l3: the final letter of pagai (and Io/Jo) has a long descender; it may be pagaj; l7: the sign after aluj looks like ʒº (ꝓo?); 'ld' after the florin sums (also l16, l27, l31) is probably an abbreviation of larghi, but its exact form (ld̄?) is unclear; l9: 'e acordo' is read from a z-like e + a; it could be 'e achordo'; l12: the lira sign looks like 'tt'; I wrote 𝓎 per the MS 1435 conventions, not Kraken's ⫳; the 'sp' after 57 is unclear (ß? sp(ese)?) and there is no figure after it; l13: the word after ꝑ looks like 'bresto/resto'; l15: the last word looks like 'restamo/restiamo'; l16: 'da auere' is uncertain (the image looks like dauad…); l18: the second ꝓ in ꝓme may be ꝑ; l20: the first word should be Firenze ('borgo san lorenzo di firenze'), but how it is abbreviated is unclear; l23: 'lape lipoe' is probably 'la p(ro)xima' or similar (cf. ꝓximo avenire in l24), but I could not read it with confidence, so I left Kraken's text; l25: 'pagamēto' could be 'pagando'; 'ꝓdita' is unclear; l31: soscripta could be sosc̄pta
